title: C++: Trie (Prefix Tree)
description: Implement a trie data structure for string prefix search.

steps.title: Trie Insert and Search
steps.description: Create a Trie class with insert(word), search(word), and startsWith(prefix). Use a struct Node with children[26] and isEnd flag. Test with 'apple', 'app', 'apricot'.
hints: struct Node { Node* children[26] = {}; bool isEnd = false; };
insert: walk/create nodes for each char, mark last as end.
search: walk nodes, check isEnd at last node.

verification.failureMessage: Test insert, search, and startsWith operations
